name: Shuni
title: Ancestor in the line of Seth
summary: Shuni (also spelled Shuni or Suni) is mentioned in the Bible as one of Gad's sons, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is counted among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household. His descendants are called the Shunites.

keyEvents.title: Listed sons of Gad
keyEvents.description: Shuni is mentioned as one of Gad's sons in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's household travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Shuni was among the seventy people in Jacob's household who moved to Egypt during the famine, when Joseph was in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The lineage of the Shunites in the census
keyEvents.description: During the census in the wilderness, Shuni's descendants, the Shunites, were counted as a distinct clan within the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Gad
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Gad, Shuni's descendants received their inheritance in the land east of the Jordan.
